cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: You aren't clearing the interrupt with this change

evidence.thread_resolution:
alexandruradovici: I did that initially, but @hudson-ayers suggested disabling them only when the transmit or receive is done (lines 338 and 354). I might be missing something though.
hudson-ayers: @alistair23 why would you disable the interrupt if you are still transmitting / still receiving?
alistair23: You don't have to disable the interrupt, but you need to clear the pending interrupt status. Currently this is done in the `disable_*()` functions
hudson-ayers: Oh, I see. I suppose this should be changed back, though renaming the function to `disable_and_clear_interrupts()` might make this clearer.
alexandruradovici: I have split the function in two.
